claim.value: The selected trial must fit the existing equipment.

provenance.rationale: P025 explicitly makes compatibility with existing equipment a condition of trial selection.

signal_basis.value: Removal tests keep equipment, the agreed deadline and other test conditions fixed. A smaller configuration repeatedly reproduces lateness while specified further removals cease to do so, using a common repetition rule and treating inconsistent outcomes as unresolved.
signal_basis.scope: Reduction testing of the selected late case.

provenance.rationale: The cited spans establish the selected case, fixed test conditions, repetition and uncertainty rules, and observed reduction pattern.
This explicit selection constraint requires no unresolved empirical relation.

rationale: The claim is a resource constraint explicitly imposed on selecting a trial from the test findings. Within that limited scope it is supported; it does not assert that the reduction signal proves an equipment-compatible trial exists or will succeed.
uncertainty: Whether a particular proposed trial meets the constraint remains to be assessed, but that does not undermine the stated requirement.
